subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Anthropic native web_search as a first-class provider now, and what opt-in, billing, domain/location, credential, and transcript replay policy should gate it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature changes hosted web access, Anthropic credential use, config surface, and encrypted server-result replay semantics that automation should not choose by default.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic provider
options.body: Accept the narrow feature only as an explicit Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with documented security, billing, fallback, and replay behavior before implementation.

options.title: Fold into server-tools design
options.body: Defer the narrow provider until the broader Anthropic server-tools tracker defines one policy for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, and server-result handling.

options.title: Decline native hosted search
options.body: Keep managed web-search providers as the supported path for now and document that Anthropic-hosted search is not planned yet.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic provider
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow feature only as an explicit Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with documented security, billing, fallback, and replay behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible current-line and issue-review trail across the provider/plugin/config decision surface.
